reports.title: Analytics & Reports
reports.subtitle: Sales, profit, product performance, stock value and reorder suggestions
reports.defGross: Gross profit = net sales revenue (after discounts, excluding sales tax) − cost of goods sold.
reports.defMargin: Gross margin % = gross profit ÷ net revenue × 100 (shown only when revenue is positive).
reports.defDiscounts: Discounts reduce revenue; cost is unchanged.
reports.defTax: Sales tax is collected for the government and is never counted as revenue or profit.
reports.defVoids: Voided sales are excluded completely and their stock is restored.
reports.defWastage: Wastage is NOT included in COGS or gross profit above. It is shown separately and subtracted below.
reports.classHint: Rules use the configurable windows in Settings. New products are never flagged.

movementReason.newProduct: Added recently, not enough history to judge.
movementReason.noStockContext: Out of sellable stock, so a slow-mover verdict would be misleading.
movementReason.noSalesInWindow: No sales in the last {{days}} days (idle {{idle}} days) while stock is available.
movementReason.lowVelocity: Selling only {{velocity}} units/day over the last {{days}} days.
movementReason.normalVelocity: Selling at a healthy pace ({{velocity}} units/day).

forecast.title: Reorder forecast (rule-based)
forecast.disclaimer: These are estimates from recent sales using fixed rules. They are not machine learning and cannot predict promotions, weather or supplier delays.
forecast.fRop: avg daily demand × lead time + safety stock
forecast.fTarget: avg daily demand × coverage days + safety stock
forecast.params: History window {{window}} days · coverage {{coverage}} days · default lead time {{lead}} days
forecast.insufficient: Only {{days}} days of history, treat with caution.

forecastReason.stockoutBeforeDelivery: About {{days}} days of stock left, less than the {{lead}}-day supplier lead time.
forecastReason.belowReorderPoint: Stock ({{stock}}) is at or below the reorder point ({{rop}}).
forecastReason.noRecentDemand: No recent demand, only safety stock is kept.
forecastReason.healthy: Enough stock for the lead time.
